entities.summary: Veneranda García-Blanco Manzano (1893–1992) was a Spanish teacher, political activist and union leader. In the 1930s, she was a socialist deputy in the Provisional Government of the Second Spanish Republic. After being exiled in France and Mexico after the Spanish Civil War, she returned to Spain in 1976. In 1945, she was a council member of the Women's International Democratic Federation.
